facts.summary: Pivotal trial discontinued as unlikely to meet primary endpoint; strategic review, 90% layoffs · Phase 3 · SYNB1934 in PKU · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The decision to end Synpheny-3 is based on results of an internal review in advance of an upcoming independent Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) assessment, which indicated the trial was unlikely to meet its primary endpoint.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Decision to end trial follows internal review of initial data indicating study unlikely to meet primary endpoint
evidence.safety: Data review found treatment to be safe and well-tolerated
evidence.program_discontinued: announced today the decision to discontinue Synpheny-3, its ongoing pivotal study of labafenogene marselecobac (SYNB1934) as a potential treatment for phenylketonuria (PKU).
